name: Superchat
description: Superchat channel plugin for OpenClaw. Sends and receives messages through the Superchat Public API, restricted to a single allowed contact.

allowFrom.description: Managed by OpenClaw DM security; the plugin locks to contactId regardless.

apiKey.description: Superchat API key (Settings > API in the Superchat web app). Sent as X-API-KEY header.

channelId.description: Default Superchat channel id for outbound sends (mc_...). Inbound is accepted from ALL channels. Find ids via GET /v1.0/channels.

whatsAppBusinessAccountId.description: Optional WhatsApp Business Account id used as default when creating WhatsApp templates.

contactId.description: The ONLY Superchat contact this channel is allowed to talk to (ct_...). Inbound messages from anyone else are dropped.

contactIdentifier.description: Identifier of that contact used for outbound sends: phone in E.164 (+49...) or email, matching the channel type.

senderName.description: Optional display name used as the 'from.name' on outbound messages.

webhookToken.description: Optional shared secret. If set, webhook deliveries must call /superchat/webhook?token=<value> or they are rejected.

dmSecurity.description: DM policy override. Defaults to 'allowlist' (only the configured contact).
